title: Issue map: search by issue number or keyword, every repository label in the Labels menu, and zoom and pan kept when filters change
story: The issue map gained a search box beside the filter menus, and Esc clears it before closing the map. The Labels menu now lists every repository label, orion's included, instead of only non-orion labels found on loaded issues; 'no other label' became 'no label'. The map no longer refits on every filter change, Reload included; it fits on first open and on Fit only.

checks.criterion: Typing a number or a word narrows the map, and clearing it restores the issues.
checks.steps: Open a repository with made-up open issues, for example #3 'Ship it' and #2 'Build the canvas'. Open the issue map. Type '#3', then '3', then 'canvas', then clear the box.
checks.expected: Only #3 for the first two, only #2 for 'canvas', and every open non-epic issue again after clearing. 'Showing N of M' updates each time.

checks.criterion: Esc clears a search before it closes the map.
checks.steps: With no filter menu open and no card pinned, type 'canvas' in the search box and press Esc, then press Esc again.
checks.expected: The first Esc empties the box and brings the issues back while the map stays open; the second Esc closes the map window.

checks.criterion: The Labels menu lists every repository label, and selecting one shows the issues that carry it.
checks.steps: Create a label 'docs-test' that no issue carries. Open the map, then open Labels.
checks.expected: 'docs-test' listed with 0/0, and 'agent-ready', 'needs-human' and 'epic' listed too. 'only' next to 'agent-ready' leaves just the agent-ready issues. 'no label' covers only issues with no label at all.

checks.criterion: With every filter at its default, every open issue that is not an epic is visible, whatever its labels.
checks.steps: Have open issues with only 'agent-ready', with only 'in-progress', and with no label. Open the map and touch nothing.
checks.expected: All of them on the map; epics and closed issues hidden.

checks.criterion: Zoom and pan are unchanged after a filter or search change.
checks.steps: Open the map, zoom in twice and drag the map aside. Tick Closed under Progress, press 'show all', then type a search.
checks.expected: The zoom percentage and the position stay the same each time. Pressing Fit refits the map.
